'''Saysmond Varg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While piloting his [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], he was killed in dogfight by a [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] pilot.<ref name="SWG" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Saysmond Varg appeared aboard a starship in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
